cards.name: House of Adhesive Tape
cards.description: Monsters with Attack Factors of 500 or lower are eliminated from the play field.

cards.name: Eatgaboon
cards.description: Monsters with Attack Factors of 1000 or less are eliminated from the play field.

cards.name: Bear Trap
cards.description: When an opposing monster's Attack Factor is 1500 or lower, it is eliminated from the play field.

cards.name: Invisible Wire
cards.description: When an opposing monster's Attack Factor is 2000 or lower, it is eliminated from the play field.

cards.name: Acid Trap Hole
cards.description: When an opposing monster's Attack Factor is 3000 or lower, it is eliminated from the play field.

cards.name: Widespread Ruin
cards.description: When an opponent's monster attacks, it is blown to smithereens and eliminated from the play field.

cards.name: Goblin Fan
cards.description: Reflects the damage of direct attack cards like Fire Sparks and Inferno back to your opponent.

cards.name: Bad Reaction to Simochi
cards.description: A card that reverses the effects of recovery cards and transforms the points to damage.

cards.name: Reverse Trap
cards.description: A card that reverses the effects of power-up cards and transforms the effects to power reduction.

cards.name: Fake Trap
cards.description: A trap card for tricking your opponent. Nothing happens when it is attacked.
